acceptanceCriteria: An explicit Watch Play action produces the selected shared-renderer tone locally through a Watch AVAudioEngine output host without a reachable iPhone.
Watch selection changes, stop, route loss, interruption, and engine failure do not cause automatic restart or remote-control iPhone playback.
The Watch UI communicates actual playback state rather than a request flag.
The Watch output control presents its current value legibly at ordinary Watch sizes, and route/timbre/output presentation does not duplicate or crowd primary controls.
notes: Planning complete. The current WatchContentView changes playbackRequested only; this Task owns the missing local audible Watch integration and the compact output-control correction reported during physical-device testing.
Do not introduce a microphone, iPhone remote-control path, cloud service, automatic resume, or unsupported background behavior.
rationale: Independent audible Watch reference-tone playback is a defined product capability and is absent from the current UI-to-renderer path.
